observed_text: The conversion event is single-electron: one occupied state at the surface, one barrier φ, one escape. There is no collective coherence volume analogous to the 10–20 nm mirror buffer.
implied_text: No collective buffer is required. One electron at a surface is the hardware. The gate lives in a surface atomic layer.
description: Negative spatial-buffer spec: the heat-opened gate is single-particle. Contrast with reflection’s 10–20 nm stack.
notes: Photoelectric twin of the same surface φ. How to query effects that do not need a spatial buffer.

observed_text: A measurable cathode current is the summed output of a large emitting area. Starving the area reduces current in proportion; it does not close the gate.
implied_text: Emitting area is a capacity, not a second spatial cliff.
description: Macroscopic J is a rate of independent escapes. Area scales the current, not the on/off of φ.
notes: No minimum emitting area is extracted. Space-charge / Child–Langmuir is a collection ceiling, not this capacity.

observed_text: Thermal attempt rates sit in the prefactor A T². Once over the barrier, vacuum transit is set by anode voltage and gap. Relative to any mechanical clock the emission, when it occurs, is already complete.
implied_text: Collection latency is not the gate. A T² is the attempt-rate prefactor, not a stored-state cycle.
description: Opening φ is not a laboratory-scale clock. Transit belongs to collection.
value_text: A T² attempt prefactor; transit is collection
notes: Theoretical A0 ≈ 1.20×10⁶ A m⁻² K⁻² is a current-density prefactor, not a period. No opening-time number is given.

observed_text: Handbook polycrystalline φ: W ≈ 4.5 eV (often 4.54 eV); Cs ~2 eV; thoriated tungsten ≈ 2.6 eV. The same φ is the photoelectric threshold of the same surface.
implied_text: φ is the load-bearing gate. Heat opens it from below via the Boltzmann tail; a photon hν > φ opens the same gate from above. Schottky lowering modifies φ; it does not replace it.
description: Thermionic emission is the photoelectric-class surface gate opened by heat rather than by a photon. Not a latch; the electron leaves.
notes: value_si is clean W φ. Faces and contamination shift tenths of an eV. Cross-cite photoelectric-threshold.

observed_text: Emission is unmeasurable when kT ≪ φ. For clean W, φ/kT ~ 170 at 300 K (kT ≈ 26 meV) and ~20 at 2500 K. A tungsten filament at room temperature emits nothing measurable.
implied_text: Under-threshold thermal input is the non-occurrence of the conversion. That is the collapse of thermionic emission.
description: Below kT ~ φ the gate stays shut. A cold tungsten part is not a cathode.
notes: The Richardson tail is thermal occupation of states above a hard barrier, not a second channel.

observed_text: Richardson–Dushman J = A T² exp(−φ/kT). Theoretical A0 ≈ 1.20×10⁶ A m⁻² K⁻². No optical illumination is required.
implied_text: Stable current density from a hot surface, with no optical drive, while surface, T, and collection field stay inside the envelope.
description: The machine’s stable product is a heat-opened surface current gated by φ.
notes: Apparent A of a technical surface is medium and is taken as a surface datum.

observed_text: QSA takes φ as a measured surface specification. It does not here derive the 4.5 eV of tungsten from a more primitive node rule.
implied_text: No derivation of W’s 4.5 eV class from a surface-dipole plus chemical-potential construction. The collapse kT ≪ φ does not depend on closing that derivation.
description: The gate is located and shown to be a surface resource; its value is not derived from node rules.
notes: File-level mapping remains High; this clause is the underived step.

observed_text: The gate is a property of the periodic lattice: a filled valence band and an empty conduction band separated by Eg. A single unit cell already carries the gap; macroscopic opacity is the summed conversion over an optical path of order 1/α.
implied_text: Hardware is a gapped lattice, not a surface φ and not a collective optical buffer. Destroying crystalline order removes the sharp edge.
description: One unit cell carries Eg. Path length sets how much light is converted, not whether the gate exists.
notes: No numerical 1/α is given; do not invent an absorption length.

observed_text: The optical cycle and the interband polarization response sit in the femtosecond neighbourhood of visible / near-IR light.
implied_text: Relative to any laboratory shutter the conversion, when allowed, is already complete.
description: Interband conversion latency sits in the femtosecond optical-cycle neighbourhood.

observed_text: Indirect-gap edges (Si, Ge, diamond) rise more slowly: the conversion also consumes or emits a phonon. Direct gaps (GaAs) open with the photon alone.
implied_text: Indirect conversion needs a lattice-clock resource just above threshold. That is an extra resource on the same Eg gate, not a second family.
description: The slower rise of α in Si and Ge is a phonon-clock requirement, not a different collapse energy.
notes: No ħω_ph number is given. A frozen lattice with no phonon occupancy would starve the indirect channel at threshold.

observed_text: Room-temperature gaps (300 K): Si Eg ≈ 1.12 eV (indirect); Ge ≈ 0.66 eV; GaAs ≈ 1.42 eV (direct); diamond ~5.5 eV.
implied_text: Eg is the load-bearing gate. Direct gaps open with the photon alone; indirect with photon plus phonon. Temperature moves Eg; it does not replace it.
description: Gap absorption is a photoelectric-class energy gate relocated into a bulk crystal.
value_text: Si Eg ≈ 1.12 eV (300 K); Ge 0.66; GaAs 1.42; diamond ~5.5
notes: value_si is Si at 300 K. Photoconductivity must share this collapse energy. Low-T limits sit higher by tens to ~100 meV.

observed_text: Below Eg the crystal has a transparency window. Below-threshold light is refracted and, at most, weakly attenuated by processes that are not interband conversion.
implied_text: Under-threshold input is the non-occurrence of the conversion. That is the collapse of the effect.
description: Below Eg the interband gate stays shut.
notes: Urbach tails and excitons are softness of the same gate, not a second channel. Free-carrier/impurity absorption can hide the window without opening this conversion.

observed_text: The edge is a property of the intact crystal: melting or amorphizing the lattice destroys the sharp crystalline edge.
implied_text: Loss of crystalline order washes the sharp edge into a smeared amorphous spectrum.
description: Destroy the periodic grid and the gate’s sharp location goes with it. Lattice-resource failure, not a change of family.

observed_text: A material-typical absorption edge and the associated split between a transmitting window and an opaque band. Ordinary wafers are optically thick in the visible once above Eg.
implied_text: Stable spectral split — window below Eg, opacity above — whenever a photon population is presented to an intact gapped lattice.
description: The machine’s stable product is a crystal-typical absorption edge, not a stored state.

observed_text: QSA here takes the measured Eg as the specification. Urbach tails and excitons are recorded as measured softness, not extra mechanisms.
implied_text: No derivation of why a given crystal has the gap it has from node rules alone. The collapse hν < Eg does not depend on that derivation.
description: The gate is located; its value is not derived from node rules.
notes: File-level mapping remains High; this clause is the underived step.

observed_text: The conversion event is one atom, one occupied inner shell. Thinning the sample reduces optical depth in proportion and does not close the atomic gate. Removing the element removes the edge.
implied_text: No collective coherence length analogous to optical reflection. One occupied inner shell is the hardware.
description: Negative spatial-buffer spec: the gate is single-particle.
notes: How to query effects that do not need a spatial buffer.

observed_text: The absorption step itself tracks the X-ray cycle (~10⁻¹⁹ s at 10 keV). The observed edge width is set in part by the core-hole lifetime (femtosecond neighbourhood for many deep holes).
implied_text: Conversion latency is the X-ray cycle. Hole lifetime is a smear of the same gate, not a second threshold.
description: Inner-shell conversion finishes on the X-ray cycle; eV-scale edge width is a clock smear of Eb.
value_text: ~10⁻¹⁹ s at 10 keV; hole lifetime fs

observed_text: Cu K-edge at 8.9789 keV (~8.98 keV class); Cu L1 at 1.096 keV. Binding energies run from tens of eV (shallow cores) to tens of keV (deep K shells).
implied_text: Shell binding energies Eb^(K), Eb^(L), … are the operating gates — the same discrete energetic lock as φ and Eg, relocated to keV.
description: The X-ray absorption edge is a photoelectric-class inner-shell energy gate.
notes: value_si is Cu K (8.979 keV). Chemical shifts of a few eV relocate the same gate. Fluorescence and Auger are relaxation after the gate opens.

observed_text: Below Eb^(s) that shell does not convert. At the Cu K-edge μ/ρ jumps from ≈38 cm² g⁻¹ to ≈278 cm² g⁻¹ only once the K channel opens.
implied_text: Under-threshold input is the non-occurrence of that shell’s conversion. That is the collapse of this edge.
description: Below the binding energy the named shell’s gate stays shut.
notes: Shallower shells and scattering may still attenuate the beam; they are other channels. Pair production at still higher energy is another family member, not this failure.

observed_text: Removing the element removes the edge. If the shell is already empty (highly ionized species) there is no jump.
implied_text: Missing hardware — no atom, or no occupied shell — closes that named gate.
description: The K-edge (or L-edge) is absent when the inner-shell node is not present.

observed_text: At the Cu K-edge μ/ρ jumps from ≈38 cm² g⁻¹ to ≈278 cm² g⁻¹. The location of the jump is an elemental fingerprint.
implied_text: An element-specific step in μ(E) at Eb^(s), reproducible enough to identify the element and, with finer structure, its local chemistry.
description: The machine’s stable product is a named-shell attenuation jump.
value_text: Cu K step at 8.979 keV; μ/ρ 38 → 278 cm² g⁻¹
notes: XANES/EXAFS ride on the open channel; they do not create a second jump. The jump exists in atomic vapours.

observed_text: QSA takes Eb^(s) from tables. It does not here derive the 8.98 keV of copper’s K shell from a more primitive node rule.
implied_text: No derivation of the keV class from node rules. The collapse hν < Eb does not depend on that derivation.
description: The gate is located and tabulated; its value is not derived from node rules.
notes: File-level mapping remains High. Chemical shifts of a few eV on a 9 keV gate are a small environmental correction to the same barrier.

observed_text: One atom or molecule is the hardware for one conversion. There is no collective buffer that must be filled before a single ionization can happen.
implied_text: A macroscopic ionized gas is the summed output of a large population. Density enters later as recombination, screening, and avalanches — sequels, not the gate.
description: Negative spatial-buffer spec: the gate is single-particle.
notes: Dielectric-breakdown owns the many-body field avalanche that uses this gate as a step.

observed_text: Optical / UV photoionization tracks the electromagnetic cycle of the ionizing photon. Electron-impact ionization is set by the collision duration. Neither is a laboratory-scale latency. Recombination times in a dilute gas can be long; that is the closing clock of the ionized state, not the opening of I.
implied_text: Opening latency is not a laboratory clock. Recombination is decay of the output, not the gate.
description: The conversion, when allowed, is already complete on any laboratory clock.
notes: No numerical opening time is given; do not invent a cycle period from the Lyman limit.

observed_text: Atomic first ionization: H I = 13.598 eV; He I = 24.587 eV. H2 I ≈ 15.43 eV. The Lyman limit is hc/I ≈ 91.2 nm.
implied_text: I is the load-bearing gate. Photons, projectiles, or a thermal tail are interchangeable opening resources for that one barrier.
description: Ionization is the cleanest single-node photoelectric-class energy gate. Not a latch; the electron leaves.
notes: value_si is hydrogen. He 24.587 eV and H2 15.43 eV sit in the same tens-of-eV class. Pair production is rest-mass creation and must not be folded into I.

observed_text: Below I this conversion does not occur. A cold atomic hydrogen cell does not conduct. At room temperature kT ≈ 0.026 eV, so I/kT ~ 500 for hydrogen: the thermal tail does not ionize a cold gas.
implied_text: Under-threshold input (hν, projectile KE, or the relevant scale of kT) is the non-occurrence of the conversion. That is the collapse of the effect.
description: Below I the gas stays neutral in this channel.
notes: Residual conductivity of a real gas is then impurities, cosmic-ray seeds, or other channels — not opening I.

observed_text: If the atom is already stripped of that electron, that particular gate is gone; a deeper gate may remain.
implied_text: Missing hardware closes that named ionization step. Multi-electron atoms are a ladder of gates, not one reusable cliff.
description: An already-empty valence slot cannot open I of that charge state.
value_text: electron already stripped; deeper I may remain
notes: Inner-shell rungs are filed as x-ray-absorption-edge.

observed_text: The Rydberg series of the species converges to I; the photoionization continuum opens at that limit. For H the Lyman limit is ≈ 91.2 nm.
implied_text: A species-specific series limit and a free-charge yield that turns on at I, plus whatever plasma or chemical sequels the freed charges support.
description: The machine’s stable product is the ionization limit plus the above-threshold free-charge yield. Remove the drive and the charges return.
notes: The ionized population is not a latched state.

observed_text: QSA takes I from the handbook. For hydrogen the Rydberg formula already is the closed description of the ladder; for many-electron atoms the number is measured.
implied_text: Many-electron I is taken, not derived from a more primitive node rule. The collapse E < I does not depend on that derivation.
description: Hydrogen’s ladder is closed by the Rydberg formula; other species’ I is a measured specification.
notes: File-level mapping remains High. Molecular appearance potentials can sit above the adiabatic I when the Franck–Condon factor at threshold is small.

observed_text: One photon plus one nearby nucleus (or other recoil partner) is the hardware for one conversion. Isolated photons in empty space do not convert. A macroscopic rate then scales with nuclear column density.
implied_text: “Nearby” is a spatial-buffer condition: the photon must pass through the Coulomb field of a mass that can recoil. Empty space, however energetic the photon, is under-provisioned.
description: Hardware is one photon plus one recoil partner. The spatial clause is mandatory, not decorative.
notes: No Coulomb-radius length is given; do not invent one. Bethe–Heitler yield scales as Z², a capacity of the nuclear partner, not a second energy gate.

observed_text: The conversion, when allowed, is a high-energy QED process on timescales far below any laboratory clock. Subsequent slowing of the pair and annihilation are later steps.
implied_text: Pair-creation latency is not a laboratory-scale clock. Annihilation witnesses the conversion; it is not the gate.
description: The conversion, when allowed, is already complete on any laboratory clock.
notes: No numerical QED time is given; do not invent ħ/2mec².

observed_text: Rest energy me c² = 510.999 keV ≈ 511 keV. The pair gate in the field of a heavy nucleus is Eγ^th = 2 me c² = 1.022 MeV. Finite nuclear mass raises the exact kinematic threshold by a fractional ~ me/M, negligible for ordinary nuclei.
implied_text: The operating gate is the rest-mass sum 2me c². It is not the unbinding of a pre-existing electron. No optical photoelectric event opens this channel.
description: Pair production is a rest-mass creation gate, not an ionization gate.
notes: Forbidden below 2mec² even in a fully ionized plasma.

observed_text: Below 1.022 MeV the pair channel is simply absent: no positrons, no subsequent 511 keV annihilation line from this process.
implied_text: Under-threshold input is the non-occurrence of the conversion. That is the collapse of the effect.
description: Below 2mec² the pair gate stays shut.
notes: Photoelectric absorption and Compton scattering may still remove photons; they are other channels.

observed_text: A photon in free space, with no nearby mass to recoil, cannot satisfy energy and momentum together; the channel remains closed at every energy.
implied_text: Spatial under-provisioning closes the channel even for Eγ > 1.022 MeV.
description: Missing recoil partner is a spatial-buffer collapse, twin of the energy cliff.
notes: Two-photon pair production in an intense photon bath is a noted extension of the same rest-mass gate, not required for the nuclear-field case.

observed_text: Pair production on an electron (triplet production) opens only at 4 me c² = 2.044 MeV.
implied_text: An electron as the only recoil partner keeps the gate shut until 2.044 MeV. Same conversion, lighter momentum sink.
description: Wrong partner raises the rest-mass gate; it does not invent a second family.

observed_text: Annihilation of a stopped positron on an electron returns two 511 keV photons. That line is the macroscopic witness that a pair was produced.
implied_text: A material- and energy-dependent pair yield above 1.022 MeV, followed by the 511 keV annihilation line, as the synchronized output of many independent photon–nucleus conversions.
description: The machine’s stable product is a pair yield plus the 511 keV line.
notes: value_si is one 511 keV photon.

observed_text: QSA takes me c² = 511 keV as a measured node specification. It does not here derive the electron mass from a more primitive resource count.
implied_text: The collapse clauses (Eγ < 1.022 MeV; no recoil partner) do not depend on that derivation.
description: The rest mass is located and measured; it is not derived from node rules.
notes: File-level mapping remains High; this clause is the underived step.

observed_text: A single ionization is not breakdown. The conversion that is this effect is a many-node avalanche: a path long enough, and a medium dense enough, that multiplication outruns loss. Paschen’s minimum is that buffer condition made visible.
implied_text: A vacuum gap and a microgap fail to spark at the same voltage as a centimetre of air because the hardware for multiplication is under-provisioned, not because I of the molecule changed.
description: Breakdown hardware is a many-node avalanche path, not a single-particle gate.
notes: Centimetre-scale uniform gaps are the geometry class for the dry-air ~3e6 V/m working number, not a universal length cliff. In a solid the corresponding buffer is a defect-rich path across the film.

observed_text: Avalanche growth, streamer crossing, and thermal runaway have nanosecond-to-microsecond (and longer, for thermal) clocks. DC, pulsed, and lightning-scale stresses therefore report different Ebd.
implied_text: That is a latency dependence of the same field gate, not a family change.
description: The field cliff moves with stress duration because the avalanche clock is finite.
notes: value_si is a mid-class marker of the stated ns–μs window, not a measured period.

observed_text: Dry air at STP, centimetre-scale roughly uniform gaps: breakdown field of order 3 MV m⁻¹ (30 kV cm⁻¹). This is an order-of-magnitude working number, not a universal constant. Common polymer films sit in a broad 10⁷–10⁸ V m⁻¹ class; thermal SiO2 in 10⁸–10⁹ V m⁻¹.
implied_text: The operating gate is a field Ebd, not a single quantum hν or I. Microscopically the avalanche still spends ionization energy I; the macroscopic lock that failed is the applied field.
description: Breakdown is a field-opened conversion. Ebd is a geometry-dependent envelope, not a first-principles constant.
notes: Electrode shape, humidity, pressure, gap, pulse length, area, and stress time all move Ebd. Holding E < Ebd costs only the leakage.

observed_text: Below Ebd the part is still an insulator and the conversion has not occurred. Pre-breakdown leakage is not the spark. Remove the field and the insulator is still an insulator.
implied_text: Under-threshold field is the non-occurrence of the conversion. That is the collapse of breakdown.
description: Below Ebd the dielectric continues to support the field; the spark does not occur.
value_text: E < Ebd (~3e6 V/m dry air, order of magnitude)
notes: The existence of a field cliff is high; any one numerical Ebd is medium or lower.

observed_text: Gases follow a Paschen relation Vbd = f(pd), with a minimum of a few hundred volts in air (commonly quoted near 300 V at a small pd). Very short gaps and very low pressures both raise the voltage needed, because an avalanche cannot develop.
implied_text: pd off the Paschen window, or a path too short for multiplication, moves the field gate or refuses the spark.
description: Spatial/density under-provisioning of the avalanche buffer is a failure twin of the field cliff.
value_text: Paschen minimum ~300 V in air; Vbd = f(pd)
notes: 300 V is a commonly quoted air minimum, not a universal constant.

observed_text: Above Ebd the usual laboratory outcome in a solid is destructive (puncture, carbonization, melted channel). A second spark then follows a damaged path, not the original material. Gases can recover after the plasma extinguishes if electrodes and chemistry allow.
implied_text: Over-threshold solids destroy the original machine along a track. The original Ebd is no longer a property of that path.
description: The post-spark object is a plasma column or carbon track, not the original insulator with a new number.
notes: Cross-cite ionization-threshold (the microscopic step) and photoconductivity (carriers without necessarily destroying the lattice).

observed_text: Below threshold: a stable insulating state (the useful operating output of the dielectric). Above threshold: a conducting channel, often irreversible in solids. There is no single material-universal Ebd analogous to 2me c².
implied_text: The clean operating envelope is the reversible side of Ebd.
description: The useful output is continued insulation below the field gate, not a stored universal Ebd.
value_text: insulator for E < Ebd; no universal Ebd

observed_text: Unlike pair production or a work function, Ebd is not a single-node energy. It depends on path, time, defects, and heat. A closed buffer/barrier specification that predicts a polymer’s Ebd from node rules is not in hand.
implied_text: QSA names a field-opened conversion class but cannot attach a first-principles Ebd. After the first spark the system is a different object and must not be treated as the original insulator with a new number.
description: The class is clear; a predictive node-rule Ebd is not. Mapping confidence is medium for that reason.
notes: File-level mapping is Medium. Contrast with refraction-dielectric (reversible below-threshold polarization of the same insulator).

observed_text: The conversion event is one absorbed photon promoting one electron (and a hole) across Eg or Et. There is no collective optical-buffer analogue of the 10–20 nm mirror. Thinning the absorber reduces the generation volume in proportion to 1−e^{−αL}.
implied_text: A measurable current is the summed drift of a large generated population between contacts. The crystal must be intact enough to support bands or defined traps, and contacted.
description: The gate is a single-event conversion inside an intact, contacted crystal. Thickness is a generation capacity, not a continuity cliff.
notes: Absorption without photocurrent (very short τ, bad contacts) and photocurrent without strong opacity (thin extrinsic layers) are both allowed.

observed_text: Generation follows the optical cycle (femtoseconds).
implied_text: Generation, when allowed, is already complete on any laboratory shutter. Bias does not replace this clock; it only reads the carriers.
description: Pair generation latency sits in the femtosecond optical-cycle neighbourhood.
notes: Same generation clock class as semiconductor-gap-absorption.

observed_text: τ spans nanoseconds in many direct-gap or dirty samples to milliseconds in high-purity Si. No single universal τ is claimed. Chopping faster than 1/τ rolls off the photocurrent. Gain Γ = τ/t_tr multiplies the current; it does not move Eg.
implied_text: The readout clock is the recombination lifetime τ and the transit time t_tr. Gain is this pair of clocks written as a performance number.
description: τ is a performance metric, not a threshold. Clock overrun of the readout is not closure of Eg.
notes: value_si is a mid-class marker of the stated ns–ms window. Lifetime is high as a class and sample-specific as a number.

observed_text: Intrinsic photoconductivity is gated by the same gaps as semiconductor-gap-absorption: Si Eg ≈ 1.12 eV, Ge ≈ 0.66 eV, GaAs ≈ 1.42 eV, diamond ~5.5 eV (all 300 K). Extrinsic photoconductivity is gated by a trap depth Et < Eg.
implied_text: The operating gate is Eg (intrinsic) or Et (extrinsic). Bias does not replace the gate; it only reads the carriers. Thermal generation across the same gate produces dark current.
description: Photoconductivity is the same Eg gate as gap absorption, read as current rather than as opacity.
value_text: Si Eg ≈ 1.12 eV (300 K); or Et < Eg extrinsic
notes: Must share this collapse energy with semiconductor-gap-absorption. value_si is Si at 300 K.

observed_text: Below Eg (or Et) this conversion does not occur. Below the edge, extra light of that colour does not raise the current through this channel. Conductance stays at the dark baseline.
implied_text: Under-threshold input is the non-occurrence of the conversion. That is the collapse of the effect.
description: Below Eg the photoconductive gate stays shut.
notes: Sub-gap current, if any, is thermal, two-photon, or defect-assisted — other channels. Raising T buries Δσ in dark current: a thermal failure of readout, not a shift of the optical gate to zero.

observed_text: τ too short → generated carriers vanish before they contribute a measurable Δσ. Absorption without photocurrent is allowed.
implied_text: The gate opened; the output did not last. That is a readout-clock failure, not a denial of Eg.
description: Clock starvation of the readout leaves the spectral gate intact.
value_text: τ too short vs t_tr / measurement
notes: Blocking contacts or a vanished bias likewise remove the current readout without closing Eg.

observed_text: A light-dependent conductance whose spectral onset tracks Eg or Et, with magnitude set by η, α, τ, and μ, reverting when generation stops. Δn = Gτ.
implied_text: Stable output is a reversible, light-dependent conductance, not a latched state and not an ejected vacuum current.
description: The machine’s product is Δσ(hν) that turns on at the gap and reverts when generation stops.
value_text: Δσ onset at Eg or Et; reverts when light off
notes: Photoelectric-threshold and work-function-thermionic eject the carrier into vacuum; this entry keeps it inside the solid.

observed_text: QSA does not here derive τ from a primitive node count. Lifetime is taken as a measured recombination resource. Gain figures of a given detector are therefore performance data, not predicted constants.
implied_text: The threshold mapping does not depend on closing that derivation.
description: Eg is located; τ and gain are taken as measured performance, not derived.
notes: File-level mapping remains High; this clause is the underived step.

observed_text: One muon plus two hydrogen-isotope nuclei (a dtμ or ddμ ion) is the hardware for one catalysis cycle. A metal lattice is not required. Target density is capacity.
implied_text: N = 1 muon + two nuclei. No collective metal film and no defect-cell KV. Density raises the cycle rate; it does not open a muon-free cell.
description: The gate hardware is one muon and two hydrogen nuclei. Target volume is capacity.
notes: Same N=1 family as photoelectric, with a different particle.

observed_text: Muon mean lifetime τμ = 2.197e-6 s (PDG 2026). Formation and fusion inside a formed dtμ ion sit far below that clock.
implied_text: τμ is the hard stop. Observation after the muon population is gone is not this effect.
description: The catalysis clock is the muon lifetime, not a lattice attempt time.
notes: Lifetime taken from PDG, same honesty as me on pair-production.

observed_text: mμ c² = 105.658 MeV; mμ/me ≈ 206.8. The muonic Bohr radius is ~a0/207, so dtμ / ddμ holds the nuclei close enough for fusion on a timescale below τμ.
implied_text: Not a latch. The muon mass rescales the well so the nuclear conversion occurs. The product leaves; the muon is recycled until it decays or sticks.
description: The gate opener is the muon mass ratio, not lattice strain and not KV.
notes: value_si is the muon rest energy. Q(dt)=17.6 MeV is the fusion release, not the gate that opens the cycle.

observed_text: The same hydrogen-isotope target with no muons produces no catalysis cycle. Cosmic-ray flux does not become this cycle just because a hydride is present.
implied_text: Missing muon is the collapse of the effect. Lattice compression and H/M do not substitute for the node.
description: No muon ⇒ channel closed. Twin of pair-production’s missing recoil partner.
notes: This is the contrast to any muon-free LENR cell.

observed_text: Each muon is erased by decay at τμ or by α-sticking. dt sticking ωs is 0.5–0.6% class; dd sticking is ~10% class. Yield is ~100–150 dt fusions per muon.
implied_text: Sticking and decay cap the cycle. They are erase of the catalyst, not a latch blocking temperature.
description: Decay and sticking are the yield cliffs of this gate.
notes: value_si is the midpoint of the dt sticking class. Any one target’s exact ⟨n⟩ is medium.

observed_text: Dense d–t yields of order 100–150 fusions per stopped muon (Los Alamos / Jones class ~150). Products appear only while muons are present.
implied_text: Stable output is fusion-product yield per stopped muon, set by supply × cycle × (1−ωs), only while muons are present.
description: The machine emits a per-muon fusion yield, not a remnant cell at 0 W.
notes: value_si is the Jones LAMPF-class upper end. Not a net-energy factory number.

observed_text: Zero muons after the beam is dark means zero catalysis. There is no remnant fusion cycle at zero muon population.
implied_text: This is not a 0 W latch. Identifying it with a defect-pinned interstitial cell is a mapping error.
description: Honest exclusion: μCF is a spent-node gate, not a hold-power memory.
value_text: not 0 W hold after muon gone
notes: Contrast membership on anisotropy-latch. Does not add a nuclear effect to the latch family.

observed_text: Island C in the aF–fF class so Ec=e²/2C exceeds kT. For C=1 fF, Ec≈80 μeV≈0.93 K.
implied_text: The island is the buffer. Too large ⇒ Ec vanishes into kT.
description: Charging-energy buffer is the island capacitance.

observed_text: Tunnel/charging rate set by RT and C.
implied_text: Observation faster than charging is not a blockade reading.
description: RC / tunnel clock.

observed_text: Ec = e²/2C. Current blocked for |eV| ≲ Ec except at degeneracy.
implied_text: Ec is the load-bearing gate. Not φ and not a latch barrier.
description: Single-electron charging gate.

observed_text: kT ≳ Ec, or RT ≲ RQ=h/e²≈25813 Ω, washes the diamonds out.
implied_text: Thermal overrun or charge not integer are the collapses.
description: T too high or RT too small kills the blockade.

observed_text: Coulomb diamonds / staircase with period e on the island.
implied_text: Stable output is a blockaded window periodic in e.
description: Diamond / staircase as the gated output.

observed_text: RQ=h/e² here is a resistance floor for charge quantization, not a Hall plateau.
implied_text: Do not identify with QHE RH.
description: Same combination h/e², different role.

observed_text: One photon plus one deuteron. Yield scales with deuterium column.
implied_text: N=1 conversion. No metal film, no muon.
description: Hardware is γ + d.

observed_text: Nuclear photodisintegration is far below any laboratory clock.
implied_text: Collection of p or n is a later step.
description: Prompt nuclear unbinding.

observed_text: Bd = 2.224 MeV. Below that the γ+d→p+n channel is closed.
implied_text: Unbinding gate of a pre-existing pn bound state.
description: 2.224 MeV deuteron unbinding gate.

observed_text: Below 2.224 MeV this channel does not occur.
implied_text: Under-threshold input is the collapse.
description: Eγ < Bd closes photodisintegration.

observed_text: Photoneutron / photoproton yield above 2.224 MeV.
implied_text: Yield of independent γd conversions.
description: Photodisintegration yield above Bd.

observed_text: Bd is the measured mass defect. QSA does not derive the nuclear force.
implied_text: Same honesty as taking me.
description: Bd taken, not derived.

observed_text: A pyroelectric crystal (LiTaO3 class) plus deuterium. Nuclear event is beam-target D–D.
implied_text: Polar crystal is the field engine; D is the nuclear fuel. No muon required.
description: Pyro crystal + D is the hardware.

observed_text: Thermal ramp of the crystal (seconds). Fusion is prompt.
implied_text: Clock is the pyro ΔT ramp, not τμ.
description: Seconds-scale ramp clock.

observed_text: ~100 kV class pyro potential puts D in the tens-of-keV beam-target window. Lower potential collapses the D–D cross section.
implied_text: Stacked gates: pyro field, then ordinary D–D Coulomb barrier.
description: Tens-of-keV D beam opens D–D.

observed_text: No ΔT ⇒ no pyro field ⇒ no neutrons. No deuterium ⇒ no D–D neutrons.
implied_text: Missing field engine or missing D closes the channel.
description: No ramp or no D is the collapse.

observed_text: 2.45 MeV D–D neutrons per thermal cycle, yield class ~10^3–10^5 (apparatus-dependent).
implied_text: Yield is a class, not a constant. Witness is the 2.45 MeV line.
description: D–D neutron burst per ramp.

value_text: not μCF; not the hydride cell
observed_text: No muon is required. A pulsed-coil hydride is not this accelerator.
implied_text: Do not identify with μCF or with the EM-LENR cell.
description: Polar-field beam gate, not a latch and not μCF.

observed_text: One neutrino plus one nucleus. Heavy N is capacity of the N² amplitude.
implied_text: Same extra-node shape as pair production, different probe.
description: Hardware is ν + nucleus.

observed_text: Weak interaction; far below laboratory clocks.
implied_text: Detector integration is collection.
description: Prompt weak scatter.

observed_text: No IBD 1.8 MeV gate. Coherence requires qR≪1 (Eν ≲ tens of MeV for mid-mass nuclei).
implied_text: The gate is the coherence window, not a rest-mass threshold.
description: qR≪1 is the operating window.

observed_text: qR≳1 (too-hard neutrino) collapses the N² channel. No nucleus ⇒ no recoil.
implied_text: Loss of coherence, not under-threshold rest-mass non-occurrence.
description: Hard scatter or missing nucleus kills CEνNS.

observed_text: Nuclear-recoil rate enhanced as N² in the coherent window (COHERENT 2017).
implied_text: N² recoils as the synchronized output of many νA events.
description: Coherent N² recoil rate.

observed_text: Laboratory recoil threshold is an instrument floor. GF and the form factor are taken.
implied_text: Do not treat the calorimeter floor as the process gate.
description: Detection floor ≠ process cliff. Mapping Medium.
